cache_note: Nightly pricing snapshot. Prices per person double occupancy. Dani should always offer to verify live availability with John.

Silversea.promo_note: Early booking 5-10% off veranda/terrace; door-to-door air often included.
Silversea.booking_note: Book 9-12 months for Alaska and Japan. Mediterranean more flexible.

Regent Seven Seas.promo_note: All-inclusive with business class air on most sailings. FREE air promotions strongest spring/fall.
Regent Seven Seas.booking_note: Holiday sailings book 12-18 months out. Scandinavia best booked by January.

Seabourn.promo_note: Thomas Keller cuisine included. Solo supplements negotiable on select sailings.
Seabourn.booking_note: Expedition sailings book 12-18 months out. Traditional 6-9 months.

Viking Ocean.promo_note: Often runs 2-for-1 base fares. No kids, no casino. Strong enrichment programming.
Viking Ocean.booking_note: Japan books 12+ months ahead. Panama Canal Nov-Jan books fast.

Oceania.promo_note: OLife perks bundle shore excursions or drink package. Dining rivals restaurants ashore.
Oceania.booking_note: New Vista-class books fast. Established ships offer more last-minute deals.

Cunard.promo_note: White Star Service. Formal nights, ballroom, afternoon tea. Grand prix for special occasions.
Cunard.booking_note: QM2 transatlantic year-round. World Voyage segments book 12+ months.

sailings.itinerary: Rhine: Amsterdam to Basel Tulip Time

AmaWaterways.promo_note: Pairs well with pre/post hotel extensions. Includes guided biking tours.
AmaWaterways.booking_note: Tulip Time and Christmas Markets book 12-18 months out.

Ponant.promo_note: French character throughout. Expedition-focused with Zodiac landings and naturalist guides.
Ponant.booking_note: North Pole and Antarctica require 12-24 months lead.

fair_winds: Silversea, Regent, and Viking are D2M strongest current sellers. 2027 Alaska and Japan corridors booking fast.
pricing_disclaimer: Prices per person double occupancy, typical range for veranda/suite. Always verify live availability — John confirms exact pricing within the hour.
